PressRelease.description: Documented press-release fields. The source does not define additional response properties or an exhaustive object contract.

date.description: Date in D.M.YYYY format. Publisher table label: Date; lowercase JSON wire key observed in the saved response.

description.description: Content of the Press Release. Publisher table label: Description; lowercase JSON wire key observed in the saved response.

link.description: Link of the Press Release. Publisher table label: Link; lowercase JSON wire key observed in the saved response.

title.description: Heading of the Press Release. Publisher table label: Title; lowercase JSON wire key observed in the saved response.

info.description: Search the Chief Executive's Office press releases. The version value is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. All times are HKT (GMT+8). If start and end are omitted, the last six months of press releases are returned; at most 400 records are returned. The documentation does not specify authentication or response media type.
info.title: Press releases issued by the Chief Executive's Office

get.description: Returns press releases issued by the Chief Executive's Office. The documented request selects English-language press releases of type press from official CE. The API documentation does not define the complete response envelope.

parameters.description: Language selector. The documented request uses en. Catalog resource listings also identify tc (Traditional Chinese) and sc (Simplified Chinese) variants.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Official identifier. The documented request uses CE.
parameters.name: official

parameters.description: Release type. The documented request uses press.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Inclusive start date in YYYYMMDD format, e.g. 20190102. Earliest accepted date is 1 July 2017. Must be used together with end.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Inclusive end date in YYYYMMDD format, e.g. 20190109. Latest accepted date is today. Must be used together with start.
parameters.name: end

schema.description: Object/results envelope observed in one source-backed saved response. Additional properties remain allowed; no universal envelope requiredness is inferred.

results.description: Documented record fields in the observed results array. Saved response contains four records; observation is not an exhaustive contract.

returned-count.description: Observed envelope key; universal type and requiredness are not specified by the publisher dictionary.

total-count.description: Observed envelope key; universal type and requiredness are not specified by the publisher dictionary.

200.description: Successful search. The documentation supplies field definitions for press-release records but does not specify the enclosing response structure. Outer object/results envelope is corroborated by one saved source-backed query, rather than specified by the field dictionary.
